terminology_caveats: Artifact: Generic 'Artifact' was not observed as a top-level category label in Google's Studio UI (which directly lists specific outputs such as '音频概览' and '演示文稿'). In ScholarRelay, '学习资料' serves as the natural extension umbrella term for generated outputs and resolves the previous catastrophic mistranslation '纹章' (heraldic crest).

Collections: Translated as '合集' rather than '集合' (which sounds like a mathematical set) or '收藏' (which is easily confused with browser bookmarks). In the current catalog, 'No collection' is rendered as '不加入合集' and 'collection' as '合集'.
Jobs: Translated as '任务' in queue-related contexts rather than '作业' (homework/industrial operations) or '工作' (generic labor/employment).
Source: Standardized to the verified Google UI term '来源' rather than the single-character abbreviation '源' (which can be ambiguous with source code or network origin).

Verified Studio & Audio dialog labels: Studio outputs follow exact Google zh-CN observations: Audio Overview -> 音频概览, Slide Deck -> 演示文稿, Video Overview -> 视频概览, Mind Map -> 思维导图, Report -> 报告, Flashcards -> 闪卡, Quiz -> 测验, Infographic -> 信息图, Data Table -> 数据表格. Audio options follow: Format -> 格式, Deep Dive -> 深入探究, Brief -> 摘要, Critique -> 评论, Debate -> 辩论, Length -> 时长, Short -> 短, Default -> 默认. Length option 'Long' is rendered as '长' to parallel '短'.

Layout and visual presets: Translated strictly as design and layout descriptors rather than unrelated dictionary senses. Corrected humorous machine-translation blunders including Kawaii ('可爱', not '日本可愛文化'), Clay ('粘土', not '粘土模式（渲染白模）'), Bricks ('积木', not '砖'), Minimal ('极简', not '最小'), Timeline ('时间线', not '假期时间表'), Auto ('自动', not '推荐加点'), Editorial ('社论排版', not '编撰'), Scientific ('科研学术', not '科学记数'), Concise ('简明', not '孔西斯'), and Paper ('论文', not '另一张纸').

Language names: Language pickers must name the language in Chinese rather than replacing English with Chinese. 'English' is corrected to '英语' (previously mistranslated as '中文'), 'French' to '法语' (previously '嘿，法国人！'), 'German' to '德语' (previously '德国'), and 'Korean' to standard zh-CN '韩语' (previously '朝鲜语').

Punctuation and formatting: All em dashes have been excluded in compliance with repository guidelines. Spaces are consistently inserted between Chinese characters and Latin terms, brands ('Gemini Notebook', 'ScholarRelay', 'Chrome', 'arXiv', 'PDF'), and numbered placeholders ('$1', '$2', etc.). All emoji prefixes are preserved exactly.
